newsitem.title: USA: Premier Laser Systems to acquire EyeSys.
newsitem.headline: Premier Laser Systems to acquire EyeSys.

text.p: Premier Laser Systems Inc on Thursday said it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire privately-held EyeSys Technologies, a developer of corneal topography systems with over 3,500 units installed around the world.

Premier Laser will pay for the Houston, Texas-based company in common stock worth $10.6 million, and it will exchange another 165,000 of options to acquire its stock for options and warrants of EyeSys.
Additional consideration may be paid upon receipt of certain license fees, Premier said in a statement.
The deal's closing is anticipated by June 30, 1997, upon receiving regulatory and shareholder approvals.
EyeSys provides Premier with a well-recognized name and international distribution channels to market Premier's current and future ophthalmic products, Premier said.
EyeSys will operate as a unit of Premier Laser under the EyeSys brand name. In its most recent 12-months ended Dec. 31, 1996, EyeSys generated revenues of about $8.1 million.
The acquisition is the culmination of Premier's strategy to acquire companies. It said the joint venture with Data Site and the EyeSys acquisition fulfills this strategy.
